description: September 16 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 3, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 16 birthday falls in Virgo, in the third decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a September 16 birthday
paragraphs: The 16th of September reduces to 7, a number linked with contemplation and solitude, and it lands at around twenty-three degrees of Virgo, where Venus colours the final decan. The result is often read as a refined, private temperament: someone who loves a well-made book, a quiet walk and a long conversation with one trusted person more than any crowd.

By noon UTC on September 16, the Sun has normally reached roughly 23° of Virgo. That places the date in the Virgo decan that astrologers give to Venus, the third of three. Venus, ruler of Taurus, softens the last decan of Virgo, from roughly September 13 to September 22. The sign's practicality is joined by an eye for beauty, comfort and craft. Late-Virgo birthdays are often linked with gardening, design, cooking or any work where precision produces something pleasant to live with. Relationships may matter more than the classic Virgo stereotype suggests, and these natives tend to show love through thoughtful, tangible acts. Venus can encourage perfectionism about appearances too. Accepting that something can be lovely and unfinished at the same time usually brings this decan real ease.

sections.heading: Numerology of the September 16 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 16th reduces as 1 + 6 = 7, giving a birthday number of 7. In the compound, the 1 of the individual meets the 6 of home and responsibility, and the result is the 7's reflective, searching mind. Numerologists sometimes list 16 as a karmic debt number, linked with humility and rebuilding after the collapse of an outdated self-image. Those born on this day are often described as introspective, intuitive and capable of real personal reinvention. The day number is secondary, but in the 16 it frequently marks a rich inner life and a habit of questioning appearances.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same September 16 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: September 16 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 16 is the 259th day of the year (260th in a leap year). In most years Libra season is under way by September 23, 7 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 16 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. September 16 is also the birthday of Kuan Yew Lee (1923), Lauren Bacall (1924) and Frans Eemil Sillanpää (1888).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 16?
faq.answer: September 16 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 16?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 16 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 2 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 16th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 16?
faq.answer: By September 16 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 16?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a September 16 birthday are Kuan Yew Lee (1923), Lauren Bacall (1924) and Frans Eemil Sillanpää (1888). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
